880-3534-8345.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control at least one additional creature.
880-3534-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1385-2760-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1385-2760-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1385-2760-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

728-3305-4022-4772-5926.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating two token copies of each creature card in your graveyard that are 1/1 Insects.
Put all but one of the Grist, Voracious Larva tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, each Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and each Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve both Hidden Herbalist triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

489-586-5258-5618-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1724-4247-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sekki.
When Sekki dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

3756-5412-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Izzet Boilerworks.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Izzet Boilerworks from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Repeat.

1653-7814.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block Tireless Tribe.
1653-7814.description:
Cast Inside Out by paying {1}{U/R}, targeting Tireless Tribe and then drawing a card.
Activate Tireless Tribe by discarding a card, giving it +4/+0 as its power and toughness are switched.
Repeat step 2 as able.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tireless Tribe.
1653-7814.notes: It's recommended to start the combo having a number of cards in hand equal to (X-5)/4, rounded up, where X is the opponent's life total. This'll ensure lethal damage to the opponent.

413-1636-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it, Blasting Station and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Belonging trigger, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
When the Shapeshifters enter, Blasting Station and Intruder Alarm triggers three times each. 
Resolve all Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures three times.
Resolve all Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Belonging.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-1722-2034-4893-7365.description:
Activate Katara by paying at most {4} due to Training Grounds, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create two creature tokens.
Activate Katara by paying at most {2} and tapping the creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Katara ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
1308-1722-2034-4893-7365.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you tap combo pieces or other applicable permanents while activating Katara's waterbend ability the first iteration. As the combo will net {C} each iteration, you can forego sacrificing and/or tapping both tokens on some loops.

2781-7193.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Omni-Changeling.
2781-7193.description:
Cast Omni-Changeling by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Omni-Changeling enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Omni-Changeling. Choose to have Omni-Changeling enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-2783-5226.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2783-5226.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Nesting Dragon and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3446-4771-5660.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1170-1329-3518-5223.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

997-2459-5220-6900.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

104-4506-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-4506-5641.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-3484-4023-4050-4840.notablePrerequisites:
Dr Madison Li does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Dr Madison Li.
You have at least five energy counters.
2178-3484-4023-4050-4840.description:
Activate Dr Madison Li's third ability by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Myr Battlepshere enters the battlefield, it and Decoction Module trigger.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
When the Myrs enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers four times.
Resolve all Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding one mana of any color.
When Myr Battlesphere dies, Dr Madison Li triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1365-4853-4907-5147.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Tatterkite persist until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tatterkite.
When Tatterkite dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Tatterkite trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters on it.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

500-2021-4365-4751.notablePrerequisites: Simic Ascendancy has at least four growth counters on it.
500-2021-4365-4751.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Verdurous Gearhulk and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Verdurous Gearhulk tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve a Verdurous Gearhulk trigger, putting four +1/+1 counters on any creature(s) you control.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting four growth counters on itself.
Repeat steps 3-4 for each remaining trigger.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with eight or more +1/+1 counters on it
attached to any creature you control except Sekki

1475-1724-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sekki
When Sekki dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating at least eight 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Sekki by sacrificing eight Spirits, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1486-3459-4461-4486.notablePrerequisites: Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness.
1486-3459-4461-4486.description:
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, causing all creatures you control to have base power and toughness 1/1 and gain all creatures types until end of turn.
Activate Battered Golem by paying {R} and tapping it.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Battered Golem ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

890-1978-2410-4777.notablePrerequisites: Myr Galvanizer, Palladium Myr and Silver Myr do not have summoning sickness.
890-1978-2410-4777.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Silver Myr by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Myr Galvanizer.
Activate Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Repeat.

914-2136-2178-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2136-2178-5231.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Dockside Extortionist token, adding {R}.
When the Dockside Extortionist token dies, Orthion triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may instead use Orthion's second ability to make copies of any creature(s) you control.

2178-4242-4331-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Drafna.
Drafna does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4242-4331-4659.description:
Cast Su-Chi by paying {4}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying the Su-Chi spell.
Resolve the copy of the Su-Chi spell, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Su-Chi token, adding {C}{C}.
The token Su-Chi dies, triggering itself and Drafna.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Drafna trigger, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1089-1218-1525-4298.notablePrerequisites:
Curiosity attached to Borborygmos.
You have a land card in hand.
You have at least eleven lands between your hand and library.
1089-1218-1525-4298.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Borborygmos +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land, dealing three infect damage to an opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library.
Repeat from step 2.
